person.headline: CEO at CodeBlue Ventures

company.name: CodeBlue Ventures
company.description:
Who We Are
We came up with a motto- "Work Hard, Play Harder." That isn't our motto, we didn't come up with it and it does not describe us. But it's a good opening, right? "Play Hard, Play Harder, Play Hardest" might be more accurate. To us, our work is our play. We're crazy about what we do, and our staff (and the hours and effort they put in), reflect that. 

How We Do It
We operate on the assumption that we can change everything, from the ground up. We take nothing for granted, and just because something has been done a certain way for forever, doesn't mean it is the optimal approach. We are open-minded and challenge the status quo of the industries we are entering. For example, Is it Private Pay or private pay? Mind blown, eh? 

Our Products
Zunta- Private Billing for Skilled Nursing Facilities optimized, streamlined and made efficient. Send Mail, Manage Collections, Receive Payments. 
Edminify- Kind of like Zunta, but different. But not really. Just a lot more complicated. Oh, and it's for schools, not nursing homes (that seems important to mention). 
Chat- Chat made easy, chat made quick (but well), chat jump over the... er, computer? Implement a chat system in your custom software, fast and cheap, with all the features you need (chatting).
Payments- Integrate a CC and ACH processor into your custom software with minimal fuss. Cheaper than Stripe, easy to integrate (for a developer).

Vision
Improve workplace efficiency with beautiful and simple products that cover all use cases. Everything boils down to yes/no, complete/incomplete, etc. so we make software that functions with the same principles in mind. Sounds simple? In essence, it is, but getting there is not. And that's what we spend our time working on and figuring out. 

We envision the relationship between technology and the healthcare and education industries to drastically change in the next few years, and we plan on being at the forefront of that change, in every way we can.

person.headline: Co-Founder, Hotplate (YC S20)

company.name: Hotplate
company.description:
Running a food business is hard, too hard. About 2/3 of brick and mortar restaurants and bakeries fail within their first year, putting these types of businesses in the same risk category as startups. It is insane that that is the case.

However, during COVID, as people were stuck at home, a new model for selling food emerged: people making and selling food in their home through social media via pre-order pickup. These new businesses opened pre-orders for a brief period at the beginning of the week and had their customers come to pickup their food at the end of the week. This seemingly small change has massive implications. By running on a pre-order pickup model, these chefs and bakers solved many of the problems traditional brick and mortars faced:
- No ingredient waste or need to forecast demand.
- Significantly less labor needed, a single creator can take the orders, make them, and hand them off to the customer over the course of the week.
- No need for an expensive lease: customers can pickup from the creator's house or a local business they partner with.
- Zero startup cost, anyone can start small and organically grow without needing to invest over $100,000 to start a traditional brick and mortar.

As we saw this trend develop, we spoke to the people behind these businesses and found out that many of them were making upwards of 50% margins on their food sales, 10x the average of 5% for a standard brick and mortar.

However, there was one big problem: no product existed to sell food this way. These businesses were taking orders via DMs, Google Sheets, or hacking the functionality of a Square or Ecommerce website to post their sales. They were spending most of their time trying to organize orders, remind customers about pickups, chasing down venmo payments, and tabulating spreadsheets. They were hitting a glass ceiling.

By building the foundational tool for this new model, we have the opportunity to fundamentally change the food industry for the better.
company.description_ai: Hotplate is a platform for food drops used by thousands of chefs and bakers to run micro-bakeries and food businesses. It offers preorder storefronts, automated customer text notifications, inventory controls, prep lists, and insights, with payment processing built in and fees only when customers place orders.
